# Tab

> Tab is a serverless group expense ledger on Arc mainnet (chain id 5042). Expenses are `Memo` events. Settlement is one netted `Multicall3From.aggregate3` batch per debtor, with a memo per leg. No backend, no database, no custody contract.

Repository: https://github.com/JUICEWRLD998/tab
License: MIT
Author: Mustapha Fadhlullah (GitHub: JUICEWRLD998)

## What to read first
- README.md: what it is, what it uses Arc for, proof transactions, how to check them, known limits.
- CLAIMS.md: every public claim mapped to a command or a mainnet transaction.
- DECISIONS.md: dated design decisions, each settled by a transaction or a command.

## Check it without a wallet (Node 22+)
- `npm install`
- `npm run verify -- 0xf0a3c947b36eaf6a8c09a064454cded790c37a141fccb50821553cbfb34463a4` rebuilds a real 3-leg settlement from its hash and exits 0 when verified.
- `npm run group -- tab-1h4j301v 24357102` reads an open demo group from the chain.
- `npm test` runs 98 tests with no network.

## Arc features used
- Memo predeploy 0x5294E9927c3306DcBaDb03fe70b92e01cCede505
- Multicall3From predeploy 0x522fAf9A91c41c443c66765030741e4AaCe147D0
- Native USDC, 6-decimal ERC-20 interface 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000
- 20 gwei fee floor, USDC blocklist pre-check, deterministic finality, EOA-only callers

## Code map
- packages/tab-core: money, equal and custom split, netting (at most N-1 transfers), memo codec, ledger trust rules
- packages/tab-chain: log reader, write path, settle batch, preflight, verifyTx
- packages/tab-web: Vite + React static app and the browser drive scripts
